issue.title: Linked-clone eviction rescue bundles pushed annotated tags, firing a false 'Rescued leftover state from linked-sase-core' notification every launch
issue.description:
Launch-time eviction rescue (`rescue_repo_clones_before_eviction`, added in 1a638eac95 / sase-1kh.1) creates a rescue entry and sends a `workspace-rescue` notification ("Rescued leftover state from linked-sase-core before workspace healing: local commits (local-commits.bundle).") on every numbered-workspace launch, even though the sase-core linked clone is clean and in sync with origin.

Root cause: `_bundle_refs()` in `src/sase/workspace_provider/rescue.py` collects all `refs/tags/*`. `_write_bundle()` relies on `git bundle create <refs> --not --remotes` to drop remote-reachable history. But `--not --remotes` excludes only commits: annotated tag objects are not reachable from any `refs/remotes/*` ref, so git bundles all 313 sase-core release tags (release-plz annotated tags). The bundle is non-empty, so a rescue entry is written and the user is notified.

Evidence (2026-10-13): 11 notifications from 15:39 to 17:29 EDT, one per launch (ws11-ws20). Every manifest under `~/.sase/rescue/202610/*-linked-sase-core-*` shows branch master, head == upstream, empty status_porcelain, 0 stashes. Each bundle is ~68 KB and lists 313 refs, all `refs/tags/*`, with no branches. The clone holds 313 annotated tags, and `git ls-remote --tags origin` lists 313.

Suggested fix: skip bundling when `git rev-list <refs> --not --remotes` is empty, or drop tags whose objects are already on the remote. Add a regression test showing that a clone whose only extra refs are pushed annotated tags gives `rescue_git_repo(...) is None`. Existing tag-only rescue entries can be deleted; the reaper also removes them after 30 days.

task_type_fields.impact: One spurious unread workspace-rescue notification plus ~68 KB tag-only rescue entry per numbered-workspace agent launch; real rescues get buried in noise. No data loss.
task_type_fields.repro:
In a temp dir: create a bare origin, clone it, make one commit, then add an annotated tag (`git tag -a v1 -m v1`) and a lightweight tag (`git tag light`). Push the branch and tags, then `git fetch`.
- `git bundle create b1 refs/heads/master refs/tags/light --not --remotes` gives `fatal: Refusing to create empty bundle.` (correct)
- `git bundle create b2 refs/heads/master refs/tags/v1 --not --remotes` creates a bundle containing `refs/tags/v1` (false positive)
In practice: launch any agent in a numbered sase workspace that has the sase-core linked clone. A new `workspace-rescue` notification appears, with a tag-only `local-commits.bundle`.

issue.creation_reason: The user asked why these rescue notifications keep arriving; research showed every one is a false positive caused by annotated tags slipping past --not --remotes, so the noise continues on every launch until fixed.

payload.description: Phase that added rescue_repo_clones_before_eviction, which surfaced this false positive
